name: OneRing OShare vault share price from spot strategy valuation
summary: OneRing's OShare vault priced shares from its strategies' USD marks, which valued Solidly stable-pool LP positions from live pool balances. With an 80M USDC flash loan the attacker called depositSafe, whose investment of the deposit imbalanced those pools and was credited at the pre-move mark, then withdrew its shares at the inflated mark for more USDC.
notes: Targets are the vault, whose share accounting consumed the marks and whose depositSafe the exploit called, and the three Solidly LP strategies the deposit was invested into, whose getUSDBalanceFromUnderlyingBalance summed live pool balances. The vault's upgrade to depositSafe is the latest; replaying the anchor on a fork just after it reproduces the profit.

Loss is the vault's net USDC paid to the attacker contract over deposit and withdraw: 1,534,753.10 in the anchor and 286,867.14 in the attacker's repeat 0x87b268c3. Its third run 0x0763a4bc lost money and is left out. USDC is valued at par; DefiLlama has no price for Fantom USDC.

No implementation has verified source (Etherscan v2 does not serve chain 250, Sourcify has none); the mechanism rests on traces, selector diffs between implementations and the SlowMist and Fairyproof analyses.
